name: fair_ontologies
releaseNotes:
This version of FOOPS! has several optimizations and improves the compliance with the FTR specification (https://w3id.org/ftr/)

## What's Changed
* improve yml action ttl_changes by @juanjemdIos in https://github.com/oeg-upm/fair_ontologies/pull/241
* Move the throw to keep with the iteration when one fails. Fixes  #112 by @juanjemdIos in https://github.com/oeg-upm/fair_ontologies/pull/243
* remove tmp folder when fail or exception. Fixes #236 by @juanjemdIos in https://github.com/oeg-upm/fair_ontologies/pull/244
* Improve logs with more info. Fixes #117 by @juanjemdIos in https://github.com/oeg-upm/fair_ontologies/pull/245
* Landing page and isDefinedBy in output. Fixes #242 by @juanjemdIos in https://github.com/oeg-upm/fair_ontologies/pull/246
* gestTest with a list of test metadata instead of an array of ids. Fixes #224 by @juanjemdIos in https://github.com/oeg-upm/fair_ontologies/pull/247
* Add version test in the JSON-LD being returned. Fixes #214 by @juanjemdIos in https://github.com/oeg-upm/fair_ontologies/pull/250
* Improve documentation for GET requests. Fixes #222 by @juanjemdIos in https://github.com/oeg-upm/fair_ontologies/pull/249
* Accept a URL in the assessment of a test. Fixes #223 by @juanjemdIos in https://github.com/oeg-upm/fair_ontologies/pull/248


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/oeg-upm/fair_ontologies/compare/v0.3.2...v0.4.0
